title: Target: Ha-Jun
summary: Supreme Director Kang issues an Alpha Red Extinction Order, mobilizing Captain Baek and fifty augmented elite hunters to encircle Ha-Jun's industrial safehouse in Seongsu-dong.

panels.shot: hunter bureau war room wide shot
panels.action: A cavernous glass-and-steel amphitheater with tiered analyst workstations surrounding a 40-foot holographic map of Seoul.
panels.prose_en: A cavernous glass-and-steel amphitheater with tiered analyst workstations surrounding a 40-foot holographic map of Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Seoul ke 40 foot ke holographic manchitra ke charon or stariya vishleshak karyasthanon wala ek gufanuma kaanch aur steel ka emfitheater.

panels.shot: supreme director kang standing at apex
panels.action: Director Kang stands with hands behind his back, silver hair slicked tight, immaculate black double-breasted trenchcoat.
panels.prose_en: Director Kang stands with hands behind his back, silver hair slicked tight, immaculate black double-breasted trenchcoat.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang apni peeth ke peeche haath rakhkar khade han, chandi ke bal kaskar, bedag kale duble-brested trenchakot.

panels.shot: holographic red ping over seongsu-dong
panels.action: A pulsating crimson crosshair locks onto an abandoned brick textile warehouse in Seongsu-dong.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET CONFIRMED: SPECIMEN HA-JUN KANG]
Wavelength: SOVEREIGN-CLASS DETECTED
Location: Industrial Sector 7, Seongsu-dong.

panels.prose_en: A pulsating crimson crosshair locks onto an abandoned brick textile warehouse in Seongsu-dong.
panels.prose_hi: Seongsu-dong mein ek parityakt int kapda godam par ek spandit crimson crosahear tala laga hua hai.

panels.shot: director kang speaking into microphone
panels.action: Director Kang speaks with icy, measured cruelty: 'Alpha Red Directive authorize kiya jata hai.'

dialogue.speaker: director_kang
dialogue.text: No capture protocols. Collateral damage authorized. Bring me his severed heart.

panels.prose_en: Director Kang speaks with icy, measured cruelty: 'Alpha Red Directive authorize kiya jata hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang barfili, napi-tuli krurta ke saath bolte han: 'alfa red directive authriz kiya jata hai.'

panels.shot: captain baek stepping forward in heavy armor
panels.action: Captain Baek adjusts his titanium-reinforced gauntlets; a massive six-foot serrated Greatsword rests on his back.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Main khud lead karunga, Director. Is baar woh mere haath se nahi bachega.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek adjusts his titanium-reinforced gauntlets; a massive six-foot serrated Greatsword rests on his back.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake ne apne titenium-prablit gauntlet ko samayojit kiya; chhah foot ki ek vishal daatedar gratusward uski peeth par tiki hui hai.

panels.shot: director kang smiling darkly
panels.action: Director Kang's lips curl into a cold smirk: 'Use my personal Chimera Serum agar zarurat pade, Captain.'
panels.prose_en: Director Kang's lips curl into a cold smirk: 'Use my personal Chimera Serum agar zarurat pade, Captain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Nirdeshak kang ke hothon par thandi muskan fail gai: 'agar jaruri pade, to mere vyaktigat chimera serum ka upyog karen, capton.'

panels.shot: armored convoy speeding through rainy seoul
panels.action: Six matte-black armored tactical carriers and two mobile disruption vans race through torrential rain.
panels.prose_en: Six matte-black armored tactical carriers and two mobile disruption vans race through torrential rain.
panels.prose_hi: Chhah mat-kale bakhtarband samrik vahak aur do mobile vyavdhan van musladhar baarish ke beech daudte han.

panels.shot: abandoned seongsu-dong textile warehouse
panels.action: A derelict red-brick industrial warehouse surrounded by rusted shipping containers in pouring rain.
panels.prose_en: A derelict red-brick industrial warehouse surrounded by rusted shipping containers in pouring rain.
panels.prose_hi: Bhari baarish mein zang lage shipping containeron se ghira ek parityakt lal-int audyogik godam.

panels.shot: inside warehouse ha-jun meditating
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged in the center of the dusty concrete floor, surrounded by floating ribbons of blood mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged in the center of the dusty concrete floor, surrounded by floating ribbons of blood mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dhul bhare concrete ke farsh ke kendra mein cross-legd baithta hai, jo khoon maina ke tairte ribbon se ghira hua hai.

panels.shot: violet hellfire swirling around his shoulders
panels.action: Wisps of violet flame dance effortlessly across his knuckles, perfectly balanced with his arterial pulse.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Flame of the Fallen... ab yeh mere gusse se nahi, mere focus se chalti hai.

panels.prose_en: Wisps of violet flame dance effortlessly across his knuckles, perfectly balanced with his arterial pulse.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni lau ki kiranen uske por par sahajta se nritya karti han, uski dhamni naadi ke saath puri tarah se santulit.

panels.shot: min-jae pacing anxiously with tablet
panels.action: Min-Jae bites his nails as perimeter thermal sensors turn deep crimson one by one.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Bahar 50 heavy heat signatures hain! Pura block surround ho chuka hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae bites his nails as perimeter thermal sensors turn deep crimson one by one.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne nakhunon ko kaatata hai kyonki paridhi thermal sensor ek-ek karke gahre lal rang mein badal jaate han.

panels.shot: kuro flapping wings onto metal girder
panels.action: Kuro looks down calmly: 'Aa gaye shikari. Yeh unka sabse bada strike force hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Captain Baek khud aaya hai. Is baar woh ordinary weapons nahi laya.

panels.prose_en: Kuro looks down calmly: 'Aa gaye shikari. Yeh unka sabse bada strike force hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro shanti se neeche dekhta hai: 'aa gaye shikari. yeh unka sabse bada strike force hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes with chilling stillness
panels.action: Ha-Jun's dual-ringed eyes snap open, radiant with sovereign violet and crimson majesty.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's dual-ringed eyes snap open, radiant with sovereign violet and crimson majesty.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki dohri ring wali aankhen khul gain, jo gahre baingani aur gahre lal rang ki mahima se chamak rahi thin.

panels.shot: sonic disruption grenades breaching windows
panels.action: Eight ceramic canister grenades smash through the glass skylights, detonating in midair.
panels.prose_en: Eight ceramic canister grenades smash through the glass skylights, detonating in midair.
panels.prose_hi: Aath siremik kanastar grenade kaanch ke roshandanon ko todte han, aur hawa mein visfot karte han.

panels.shot: high-frequency ultrasonic soundwaves blasting
panels.action: Intense 140-decibel anti-mana soundwaves distort the air, designed to paralyze demon nervous systems.
panels.prose_en: Intense 140-decibel anti-mana soundwaves distort the air, designed to paralyze demon nervous systems.
panels.prose_hi: Teevra 140-desible anti-man dhwani tarangen hawa ko vikrit karti han, jo danav tantrika tantra ko pangu banane ke liye design ki gai han.

panels.shot: min-jae collapsing clutching bleeding ears
panels.action: Min-Jae collapses to his knees, screaming as blood trickles from his eardrums.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae collapses to his knees, screaming as blood trickles from his eardrums.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je chillate hue ghutnon ke bal gir jata hai aur uske kaan ke parde se khoon bahane lagta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing unaffected
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands up effortlessly; his Bone Gauntlet resonates with an acoustic nullifying barrier.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bone of the Forgotten... vibrations ko absorb kar leti hai. Inka sound weapon mujhpar beasar hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands up effortlessly; his Bone Gauntlet resonates with an acoustic nullifying barrier.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sahajta se khada ho jata hai; uska bone gauntlet ek dhwanik ashakt avrodh ke saath pratidhvanit hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun casting blood shield over min-jae
panels.action: Ha-Jun flicks his ring finger, projecting a protective dome of hardened crystalline blood around Min-Jae.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, is dome ke andar raho. Kuch nahi hoga tumhe.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flicks his ring finger, projecting a protective dome of hardened crystalline blood around Min-Jae.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni anamika ungli ko hilata hai, jisse min-je ke charon or kathor crystaliy khoon ka ek surakshatmak gumbad dikhai deta hai.

panels.shot: warehouse heavy iron doors blown off hinges
panels.action: The massive corrugated steel sliding doors are blown twenty feet inward by breaching C4 charges.
panels.prose_en: The massive corrugated steel sliding doors are blown twenty feet inward by breaching C4 charges.
panels.prose_hi: Bade paimane par nalidar steel ke sliding darvaje C4 charge ko todkar bees feet andar ki or ud jaate han.

panels.shot: smoke clearing to reveal elite hunter phalanx
panels.action: Twenty heavily armed hunters in tactical exo-suits advance in disciplined shield-and-spear formation.
panels.prose_en: Twenty heavily armed hunters in tactical exo-suits advance in disciplined shield-and-spear formation.
panels.prose_hi: Samarik exo-suit mein bees bhari hathiyaron se lais shikari anushasit dhal-aur-bhala gathan mein aage badhte han.

panels.shot: hunters firing automatic silver flechette guns
panels.action: A hail of five hundred micro-flechette silver needles sprays across the warehouse like razor rain.
panels.prose_en: A hail of five hundred micro-flechette silver needles sprays across the warehouse like razor rain.
panels.prose_hi: Panch sau micro-flechet chandi ki suiyon ki ek olavrishti ustara baarish ki tarah poore godam mein fail jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting dual bloodfire katanas
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws two streams of blood from his ring, igniting them into twin blazing violet-crimson katanas.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws two streams of blood from his ring, igniting them into twin blazing violet-crimson katanas.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni anguthi se khoon ki do dharayen khinchta hai, aur unhen judwa dhadhakte bangni-lal rang ke katana mein prajvalit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun blurring into a cyclone of slashes
panels.action: Ha-Jun spins into a blur of light; his twin blades deflect every single needle with blinding sparks.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun spins into a blur of light; his twin blades deflect every single needle with blinding sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun prakash ke dhundhlepan mein ghumta hai; uske judwan blade chakachaundh kar dene wali chingari se har ek sui ko vikshepit kar dete han.

panels.shot: closing the distance at Mach 1
panels.action: Ha-Jun vanishes in a violet thunderclap, reappearing instantaneously inside the hunter frontline.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun vanishes in a violet thunderclap, reappearing instantaneously inside the hunter frontline.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek baingani gadgdahat ke saath gayab ho jata hai, aur turant shikari ki seema rekha ke andar phir se prakat hota hai.

panels.shot: horizontal double-slash cleaving exo-suits
panels.action: His twin blades slice horizontally through four exo-suits, shattering their power cores instantly.
panels.prose_en: His twin blades slice horizontally through four exo-suits, shattering their power cores instantly.
panels.prose_hi: Uske judwan blade kshaitij roop se char exo-suton ko kaatate han, jisse unke power core turant bikhar jaate han.

panels.shot: four hunters sent flying into shipping crates
panels.action: The four elite operatives crash violently into wooden shipping crates, completely incapacitated.
panels.prose_en: The four elite operatives crash violently into wooden shipping crates, completely incapacitated.
panels.prose_hi: Char sambhrant karyakarta puri tarah se aksham hokar lakdi ke shipping bakson se hinsak tarike se takrate han.

panels.shot: remaining hunters backing away in terror
panels.action: The remaining sixteen hunters lower their weapons, trembling as they witness godlike speed.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_subordinate
dialogue.text: Yeh... Yeh koi C-Rank fugitive nahi hai... Yeh SSS-Rank monster hai!

panels.prose_en: The remaining sixteen hunters lower their weapons, trembling as they witness godlike speed.
panels.prose_hi: Shesh solah shikariyon ne devatulya gati dekhkar kampate hue apne hathiyar neeche kar die.

panels.shot: heavy metallic footsteps approaching outside
panels.action: Slow, rhythmic, earth-shaking footsteps approach through the smoking entrance.
panels.prose_en: Slow, rhythmic, earth-shaking footsteps approach through the smoking entrance.
panels.prose_hi: Dhimi, laybaddh, dharti hila dene wali padchaap dhumrapan pravesh dwar se hokar gujarti hai.

panels.shot: captain baek silhouette framed in doorway
panels.action: Captain Baek stands framed against the pouring rain, his six-foot Eclipse Greatsword dragging on the concrete.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Hat jao, baccho. Yeh fight tumhare level ki nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek stands framed against the pouring rain, his six-foot Eclipse Greatsword dragging on the concrete.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak musladhar baarish ke beech khada hai, uski chhah foot ki aclips gratusward concrete par ghist rahi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and captain baek locking eyes across warehouse
panels.action: Ha-Jun points his flaming blood katana straight at Captain Baek's throat: 'Tumhara intezaar tha, Captain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Apni talwar uthao. Is baar main peeche nahi hatunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points his flaming blood katana straight at Captain Baek's throat: 'Tumhara intezaar tha, Captain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna dhadhkta hua khoon katana sidhe captain bak ke gale ki or ingit karta hai: 'tumhara intjaar tha, capton.'
